links.title: The Definitive KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) API Documentation — The Linux Kernel  documentation
links.excerpt:
1. General description ¶ The kvm API is centered around different kinds of file descriptors
and ioctls that can be issued to these file descriptors.  An initial
open(“/dev/kvm”) obtains a handle to the kvm subsystem; this handle
can be used to issue system ioctls.  A KVM_CREATE_VM ioctl on this
hand

links.title: Control Group v2 — The Linux Kernel  documentation
links.excerpt:
Introduction ¶ “cgroup” stands for “control group” and is never capitalized.  The
singular form is used to designate the whole feature and also as a
qualifier as in “cgroup controllers”.  When explicitly referring to
multiple individual control groups, the plural form “cgroups” is used.
links.label: Linux Kernel Control Group v2 — Introduction (accessed 2026-11-04)
